teams.seating: Partners sit opposite. Seats 0 opposite 2 (Team A); seats 1 opposite 3 (Team B).

deal.shuffle: cryptographically strong RNG in production; any fair shuffle in offline
deal.specialDeal: after animals: shuffle 14 specials, deal 2 per player
deal.firstLead: For the first hand of a match, choose a random seat to lead. For later hands, the player who won the last trick of the previous hand leads (if unavailable, random among remaining).

superiorSuit.rule: After a trick is won, the printed suit of the winning animal becomes the Superior Suit for the next trick. The first trick of each hand has no Superior Suit.
superiorSuit.withAnchor: If Anchor is played by the winner, that Superior Suit remains for the next two tricks (the immediate next trick and the one after), then normal updating resumes.
examples: Trick 1 has no Superior. Led suit Birds. Highest Bird wins with Falcon. Superior for Trick 2 becomes Birds.
Trick 2 Superior=Birds. Player void in led Carnivores plays a Bird (Superior) and wins. Superior for Trick 3 becomes Birds again (winner's printed suit).
Winner plays Anchor after Trick 2. Superior Birds is locked for Trick 3 and Trick 4.

trick.followSuit: If you hold at least one card of the led suit, you must play a card of that suit.
trick.void: If you hold none of the led suit, you may play any animal card.
resolutionOrder: Cards whose effective suit equals Superior outrank all non-Superior cards
Among Superior cards, highest effective strength wins
If no Superior card was played, highest effective strength among led-suit cards wins
Off-suit non-Superior cards cannot win if any led-suit or Superior card exists
If effective strength ties on the winning track, the earliest played of those tied cards wins
trick.effectiveStrength: powerBarFill from rank-model, plus Adrenaline/Poison deltas

scoring.hand: First team to win 7 tricks wins the hand. Remaining undealt tricks are not required once 7 is reached (implementation may finish the hand for UX; rules winner is first to 7).
scoring.match: First team to win 3 hands wins the match.
scoring.rematch: Players may agree to a new match; seats may rotate by agreement or stay fixed.

conduct.surrender: A player may surrender the match for their team only with partner confirmation in online mode; in hotseat, single confirmation. Surrender awards the match to opponents.
conduct.disconnect: Online: reconnect window 60s; if not restored, AI temporary take-over for the hand or hand forfeit per server policy. Rules perspective: the match must remain resolvable without soft-lock.
conduct.inactivity: Online: 60s play timer default; on timeout auto-play lowest legal animal (no special). Repeated timeouts may trigger disconnect policy.

modes.connected: Authenticated users; future tournaments/rewards hook into match results without changing core rules.

lorePolicy: Lore enriches presentation; legal moves are fully defined by this rules object and special-cards.json without story knowledge.
